column1: Welrod's delayed damage mechanic determines the value of its stored damage based on HP, and this weapon provides HP and damage bonuses. It strengthens Welrod's functionality and output capability as a Bulwark-class Doll.
column2: Mekanik damage tertunda milik Welrod menentukan nilai damage tersimpannya berdasarkan HP, dan senjata ini memberi bonus HP sekaligus damage. Ini memperkuat fungsi dan kemampuan output Welrod sebagai Doll kelas Bulwark.

column1: Welrod's damage-delaying mechanic makes it very easy for her to meet the full HP requirement, which allows her to benefit from this weapon's damage multiplier.
column2: Mekanik penundaan damage Welrod membuatnya sangat gampang memenuhi syarat HP penuh, sehingga dia bisa menikmati damage multiplier senjata ini.

column1: Fixed Key: In battles with high survival pressure, Fixed Key: Orthodox Logic and Fixed Key: The Last Case can strengthen Welrod's self-preservation ability in the delayed damage mechanic. Welrod can apply debuffs to the enemy, and Common Key: Reliable Technology and Common Key: The Night Never Ends both provide damage bonuses based on debuffs.
column2: Fixed Key: di pertempuran dengan tekanan bertahan hidup tinggi, Fixed Key: Orthodox Logic dan Fixed Key: The Last Case bisa memperkuat kemampuan Welrod menjaga diri dalam mekanik damage tertunda. Fixed Key: Two-in-One Detective bisa mengurangi Fixed damage yang diterima dan menghabiskan damage tertimbun lebih cepat, sehingga daya tahannya menguat.\nCommon Key: Common Key: Van Dine's Rules memberi bonus damage, dan Welrod gampang memenuhi syarat perbandingan HP-nya. Welrod bisa menempelkan debuff ke musuh, dan Common Key: Reliable Technology serta Common Key: The Night Never Ends sama-sama memberi bonus damage berdasarkan debuff.

column1: Fixed Keys: In battles where damage output is key, Fixed Key - Two-In-One Detective increases the rate at which accumulated damage is depleted, which synergizes with various effects which grant bonuses when damaged. Fixed Key - Hellhound Hunt and Fixed Key - Evidence Collection increase damage dealt to bosses and provide buff cleansing, which help establish the conditions needed for increased damage output.\nCommon Keys: Common Key - Van Dine's Rules provides a multiplier to damage and Welrod can easily satisfy the HP proportion requirement for it. column2: Fixed Key: di pertempuran yang mengutamakan output damage, Fixed Key - Two-In-One Detective mempercepat terkurasnya damage tertimbun, dan itu bersinergi dengan berbagai efek yang memberi bonus saat terkena damage. Fixed Key - Hellhound Hunt dan Fixed Key - Evidence Collection menaikkan damage ke boss serta membersihkan buff, sehingga syarat untuk output damage yang lebih besar terpenuhi.\nCommon Key: Common Key - Van Dine's Rules memberi damage multiplier dan Welrod gampang memenuhi syarat proporsi HP-nya. Welrod juga bisa menempelkan debuff ke musuh, dan Common Key - Reliable Technology serta Common Key - Endless Night menaikkan damage berdasarkan debuff yang tertempel.

column1: Part of Mityl's damage output comes from her summons, which her weapon's buffs cover. In addition, Mityl's ability to generate Hydro tiles allows her to easily improve her own performance and that of her summons.
column2: Sebagian output damage Mityl datang dari summon-nya, dan buff senjatanya mencakup itu. Selain itu, kemampuan Mityl menghasilkan tile Hydro membuatnya gampang menaikkan performa dirinya sendiri maupun summon-nya.

column1: Mityl has excellent Hydro tile generation ability, which allows her to easily benefit from her weapon's damage buff.
column2: Mityl punya kemampuan menghasilkan tile Hydro yang luar biasa, sehingga dia gampang menikmati buff damage dari senjatanya.

column1: Fixed Keys: Fixed Key - Tearjerker Performance ensures the target will wind up on Hydro tiles, which triggers various forms of damage buffs. The Fixed Key - Trendsetter allows Mityl to be considered a summon, which allows her to benefit from her teammates' summon damage buffs and further increase her maximum damage. The Hydro tiles Mityl creates also trigger the effects of the Fixed Key - Indistinguishable and quickly push it to its maximum performance. \nCommon Keys: Mityl can easily trigger the effects of the Common Key - Stuart Mityl. Meanwhile, the Common Key - Big Money Girl and the Common Key - Master's Command can directly increase the damage of Mityl's summons.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Tearjerker Performance memastikan target berakhir di atas tile Hydro, yang memicu berbagai bentuk buff damage. Fixed Key - Trendsetter membuat Mityl dianggap sebagai summon, sehingga dia bisa menikmati buff damage summon dari rekan setimnya dan menaikkan damage maksimalnya lebih jauh. Tile Hydro yang dibuat Mityl juga memicu efek Fixed Key - Indistinguishable dan cepat mendorongnya ke performa maksimal. \nCommon Key: Mityl gampang memicu efek Common Key - Stuart Mityl. Sementara itu, Common Key - Big Money Girl dan Common Key - Master's Command bisa langsung menaikkan damage summon Mityl.

column2: Sebagai Doll support, Springfield bisa heal unit sekutu sambil melukai musuh, dan dia bisa menaikkan potensi efek tipe Hydro di kedua sisi. Ini selaras sempurna dengan efek M1903 yang menaikkan heal dan damage terhadap unit yang terkena efek tipe Hydro.

column1: Fixed Keys: Her Fixed Key - Coalesced Core pulls all enemy units toward the center of the effect, helping with the temam's damage output. The Fixed Key - Airborne Link increases her teammates' defense, while her Fixed Key - Behind the Smile applies Hydro weaknesses to enemy units, improving the damage output of Hydro-element Dolls on the team.\nShared Key: Her Shared Key increases her ability to recover stablity and ensures the teams' stability is in a healthy place, thus increasing her survivability. Increasing her out-of-turn damage improves Taryz' damage and thus her own damage output.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Coalesced Core miliknya menarik semua unit musuh ke pusat efek, sehingga membantu output damage tim. Fixed Key - Airborne Link menaikkan defense rekan setimnya, sementara Fixed Key - Behind the Smile menempelkan kelemahan Hydro ke unit musuh, sehingga output damage Doll berelemen Hydro di tim ikut naik.\nShared Key: Shared Key miliknya menaikkan kemampuannya memulihkan stability dan menjaga stability tim tetap sehat, sehingga daya tahannya naik. Menaikkan damage di luar gilirannya memperbaiki damage Taryz sekaligus output damage-nya sendiri.
